LESSON: POVERTY REDUCTION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.3: Poverty Reduction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Poverty Reduction
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the measures taken by African governments to reduce poverty?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the causes of poverty in Africa
2. apply creative thinking skills to reduce poverty in the society

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the causes of poverty in Africa

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the causes of poverty in Africa.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain the causes of poverty in Africa” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain the causes of poverty in Africa” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the causes of poverty in Africa" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: apply creative thinking skills to reduce poverty in the society

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply creative thinking skills to reduce poverty in the society.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply creative thinking skills to reduce poverty in the society” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply creative thinking skills to reduce poverty in the society” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply creative thinking skills to reduce poverty in the society" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the causes of poverty in Africa
• Model 2: apply creative thinking skills to reduce poverty in the society

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the causes of poverty in Africa
2. Practise: apply creative thinking skills to reduce poverty in the society

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Poverty Reduction.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the measures taken by African governments to reduce poverty?
2. How does prudent utilisation of resources help to reduce poverty in society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the causes of poverty in Africa
• apply creative thinking skills to reduce poverty in the society

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
